description.en: The ID of the deployment set to delete.

description.zh: 部署集所属地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the deployment set. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent Alibaba Cloud region list.

descriptions.zh: 在删除部署集之前请确保部署集内没有实例。如果存在实例，必须移出或者释放实例后才能删除部署集，具体操作，请参见[调整实例所属部署集](~~108407~~)和[释放ECS实例](~~25442~~)。
descriptions.en: Before you delete a deployment set, make sure that no instances are in the deployment set. If instances exist, you must remove or release the instances before you can delete the deployment set. For more information, see [Change the deployment set of an instance](~~108407~~) and [Release an ECS instance](~~25442~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs delete-deployment-set --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --deployment-set-id ds-bp1g5ahlkal88d7x0000 --region cn-hangzhou
